Intro: Here's what's new since your last digest:
Footer: This is an automated message from your Jellyfin server.
EmptyDigest: Nothing new since your last digest.
AdminOutcomeAccepted: The SMTP server accepted the request. This does not guarantee the message reaches the mailbox.
AdminOutcomeInvalidRequest: The settings or the address are not valid, so nothing was sent. Check the SMTP settings and the password.
AdminOutcomeConnectionFailed: Could not connect to the SMTP server. Check the host, port and network.
AdminOutcomeTlsFailed: A secure connection could not be established. The server may not support the chosen encryption, or its certificate is not trusted. The connection was not continued without encryption.
AdminOutcomeAuthenticationFailed: The server rejected the username or password.
AdminOutcomeSenderRejected: The server rejected the sender address.
AdminOutcomeRecipientRejected: The server rejected the recipient address.
AdminOutcomeTimeout: The SMTP server did not answer in time.
AdminOutcomeUnexpectedError: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Jellyfin log for details.
TestEmailBody: This is a test message from the Email Digest plugin, sent because an administrator asked for it. If you can read it, the SMTP server accepted it. No media information is included.
AdminIntro: Configure how digest emails are sent. Nothing is sent until digest delivery is enabled in a later release; the tests below send only what you ask for.
AdminDigestEnabledDesc: Master switch for the digest feature. No emails are sent while this is off.
AdminDefaultLanguageDesc: Used for a user who has not chosen their own digest language.
AdminLookbackDesc: How far back to look for new media on the very first run, before any checkpoint exists.
AdminSmtpEnabledDesc: Allows the plugin to send mail through the server below.
AdminUnencryptedWarning: Warning: unencrypted SMTP sends every message, including its content and recipient, in clear text, and cannot be used with a username or password. Use it only on a trusted private network.
AdminUsernameDesc: Leave empty if the server needs no login. Login requires encryption.
AdminSaveFailed: Could not save. Check the values and try again.
AdminPasswordDesc: The password is write-only: it is never shown again and never sent back to this page.
AdminPasswordStatusStored: A password is set. It is stored on the server as plain text in the plugin folder, protected only by file permissions.
AdminPasswordStatusExternal: The password is provided by the server deployment (a Docker secret) and cannot be changed here.
AdminPasswordInvalid: That password is not allowed (empty, over 512 characters, or contains control characters).
AdminPasswordExternal: The password is managed by the server deployment and cannot be changed here.
AdminTestSaveFirst: Save your changes before testing. Tests use the saved settings.
AdminTestConnectionDesc: Connects and logs in. Sends no email.
AdminTestSendDesc: Sends one short message to this address only.
AdminThrottled: Please wait a few seconds before sending another test email.
AdminUnexpected: Something went wrong. Check the Jellyfin log.
AdminPasswordReenter: The SMTP server settings changed, so the stored password was removed. Enter the password again.
AdminDryRunDesc: While on, a digest run builds and checks each user's digest and logs counts, but sends nothing and records nothing. Turn it off only when you are ready for real emails.
AdminMaxPerSectionDesc: Items beyond this are not lost: they appear in the user's next digest.
AdminMaxEpisodesDesc: The series line still shows how many new episodes there are.
